statewide_source.service: Florida Statewide Parcels (ArcGIS Online item efa909d6b1c841d298b0a649e7f71cf2, owner FloridaGIO, org Gh9awoU677aKree0), layer 0 CADASTRAL_DOR
statewide_source.publisher: Florida Geographic Information Office (FGIO, FDEP) hosting; data compiled by Florida Department of Revenue, Property Tax Oversight (PTO) from all 67 county property appraisers
statewide_source.county_filter: CO_NO = <FL DOR county number 11..77> (alphabetical; 23 = Miami-Dade). Exclude CO_NO=0 (~97k blank junk rows).
statewide_source.vintage: 2026 tax roll (ASMNT_YR=2026 on every live query). DOR collects GIS from property appraisers each April/July; 'This GIS data was exported from these file submissions in August 2026'. AGOL item modified 2026-09-30; layer data last edit 2026-09-29. DOR updates annually every August, minor maintenance May and November.
statewide_source.terms: DOR disclaimer: data owned by each county property appraiser; DOR does not guarantee accuracy/completeness; not a substitute for a professional survey. Confidential (Ch. 119 F.S.) records are redacted by counties.
statewide_source.query_tips: Plain where CO_NO=n works for small/mid counties; for the biggest (Miami-Dade 23, Palm Beach 60, Broward 16) attribute-only where clauses time out (HTTP 400 'Unable to perform query'). Always query by envelope/polygon + CO_NO (returns in 1-6 s). Statewide group-by statistics also time out.
statewide_source.deed_caveat: OR_BOOK1/OR_PAGE1 and CLERK_NO1 are the DOR NAL 'sale 1' fields: only parcels with a sale in the roll's sale window (2025-2026 in samples) have them, ~0-19% per county. They are NOT the current deed for unsold parcels. All 67 counties are therefore 'partial' (owner+PID full, deed sparse).
statewide_source.alt_mirror: LABINS (FREAC) also mirrors DOR parcels: https://maps.freac.fsu.edu/arcgis/rest/services/LABINS/LABINS_Data_ccr_relate/MapServer/12 (10,266,498 rows, 3857, older roll)
